Recorded claim:
`calendar-dialog.mjs` retains the displayed occurrence and receives an `onEventResponse` callback via `setCalendarEvent(event, onEventResponse)`. Clone that occurrence and its invited attendee, set `participationStatus`, and invoke the normal callback with `{ responseMode: Ci.calIItipItem.AUTO }`. [Task 1]
